name: Haldir
subtitle: Emissary of the Galadhrim
game_text:
While no opponent controls a site, Haldir is strength +2.
<phase>Regroup</phase>: Exert Haldir at a battleground and exert another Elf to liberate a site.
flavor_text: “‘In days of old, my people stood beside the King of Gondor — we come to honor that allegiance.’”
